name: engine_oil_reset
intent: Reset the ECM's engine-oil life / change counter after an oil change.
status_note: Research is in progress. steps is EMPTY on purpose: no bytes are invented. Fill steps (from published documentation, open-source code or a published trace) in CUORE_STATE_DIR/procedures/engine_oil_reset.json; cite it in source.

session.note: bus and bitrate are the confirmed CAN-C values; the diagnostic session (0x10 sub-function) comes with the source steps

read_back.label: DID ids from service_dids discovery candidates; unconfirmed until one changes after a real reset

preconditions.label: engine running: from MES prompts (conflicts with CUORE's run_actuator interlock engine-off; the gate reports it as needing an owner decision)
preconditions.voltage_note: recorded by the owner at run time; not assumed

postconditions.label: from MES prompts / assumed: engine stopped afterwards

verification_rule: Read the ECM oil counter before and after; PASS only if it returns to its fresh-oil value in the live DID read.
